name: Plan
focus: Make the goal clear enough to act on.
summary: Turn the upload-recovery request into scope, constraints and acceptance criteria.
input: A business goal, existing behavior and constraints
outline: What happens when an upload is interrupted?
What should a user be able to recover?
Which permissions and file limits must hold?

name: Design
focus: Connect the request to the existing system.
summary: Explore upload state, retries and document identity before choosing a recovery approach.
outline: Document identity, parser attempts and storage
human: Choose the approach and settle tradeoffs

name: Build
focus: Turn the accepted design into a change.
summary: Plan the implementation, add regression coverage and simplify unnecessary complexity.
input: Accepted design, implementation plan and conventions
human: Review scope changes and technical risks

name: Test
summary: Give the verifier the plan and the changed flow, with clear behavior to inspect.
input: The change, agreed behavior and runnable checks
outline: Main recovery flow and neighboring behavior
What was actually seen when checks ran
Any behavior that differs from the plan

name: Deploy
summary: Collect release requirements and recovery steps for a named decision owner.
input: Reviewed change, verification evidence and environment rules

name: Maintain
focus: Bring findings back into the next change.
summary: Use incident evidence to define follow-up work and improve reusable knowledge.
input: Incident records, user feedback or monitoring findings
outline: Regression cases and knowledge to update
